review.notes: Full review. All 15 sampled sections and all 40 Lean statements checked by computation (families enumerated for small parameters, the Hoffman-Singleton relation enumerated on 50 vertices, Krein, complement, design and Bruck-Ryser-Chowla examples recomputed); every stated theorem holds. Findings: a false sentence in the overview (projective planes as the symmetric designs with lambda = 1; the triangle) and a false step in the proof route of 2.1 (parameters (10,6,4,2)). Sources: only Nica readable (arXiv version), 3 locators verified; Brouwer-Haemers, Brouwer-Van Maldeghem, Godsil-Royle, CRS, BCN, Biggs not readable legally, 59 locators unverified. Library: 33 Mathlib and 7 Tau Ceti declarations checked at the pins. 25 cross-roadmap citations resolved at open heads or main. Elaboration: 40 sorry warnings, no error. Dependency check: 0 problems. One-tactic padding probe: nine statements, none closed. The one automatic check that failed (a section header without a declaration) is real and is a format note.
